fieldValues.title: Views L1
fieldValues.extension_adds: Views: named, versioned presentations over a Field set — which field rows appear, in what order, under what labels, with what editor hints, and whether each is visible — required for rendering and export workflows.
fieldValues.extension_cost_of_non_adoption: Without it, a Record's Fields can be read directly but there is no named, versioned presentation layer governing which rows a rendering or export workflow shows, in what order, under what labels, or with what visibility.

sourceRefs.note: Extension ext:views-l1 from srs-spec.md - coarse source anchoring during migration
